text:
mira: Heads-up — CI on main is red but only on macOS runners. pyright and linux jobs green, macOS shows pre-commit -> mypy and rustfmt errors.
jon: link to CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/8923 (macOS job).
sylvia: can someone paste the failing mypy output? I only see the pre-commit summary.
mira: pasted below:
```
pre-commit run --all-files
mypy...............................................................Failed
- hook id: mypy
- exit code: 1
src/redwood/kvcache/cache.py:142: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]", expected "Mapping[str, Any]")
```
jon: rustfmt also changed formatting on a generated file: `cli/targets/mod.rs` — macOS runner has rustfmt 1.65 while linux uses 1.64 in our matrix.
sylvia: oh interesting. Could be rustfmt version skew + mypy stricter on macOS Python env?
ci-bot: Retrigger suggested: please run `rerun job` for 8923 to confirm flake. (automated note)
mira: I don't want a blind rerun — looks deterministic. My hunch: pre-commit is installing deps differently on macOS (parallelism/venv). Can someone run pre-commit locally on mac with latest rustfmt to reproduce?
jon: I can reproduce mypy locally using python 3.11 (macos devbox). Fails same line. Looks like a typing edge-case introduced in commit 1a2b3c4 (PR #4207).
sylvia: ok can we bisect quickly? If it's that commit, rolling back type narrowing in cache.py is small.
mira: Before bisect, try quick workaround: update the offending return annotation to Optional and see if tests pass. That will tell us if this is type-only regression.
jon: I'll push a tiny patch to branch `triage/1717654321-mypy-optional` with annotation change and trigger only macOS job.
ci-bot: Job triggered: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/8930 (macOS only).
jon: macOS job green on that branch. rustfmt failure persists though — different PR?
sylvia: For rustfmt, can we pin toolchain in CI to 1.65 across runners? Devops-jen, is that feasible?
devops-jen: We can either pin via rustup override in workspace or install specific rustfmt in the macOS image. Both ok, prefer workspace override via rust-toolchain.toml. Will send a small PR.
mira: OK next steps: 1) merge jon's type-annotation patch to unbreak the gate if it's safe; 2) devops-jen to pin rustfmt/toolchain; 3) add a CI matrix check to ensure identical rustfmt across OSes.
jon: I opened PR #4212 for the type change (link in the build). Please review quick.
sylvia: quick review ✅ — safe change. I left a nit about a comment.
mira: After we merge, let's run a full main CI. If macOS passes, close this thread.
devops-jen: I'll open infra PR for rust-toolchain.toml and queue an infra-only run.
jon: thanks all. If anyone sees other macOS-only failures in the next day ping here.
sylvia: noted, thanks. :thumbsup:
